Done. All three functions implemented and exported:

1. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to human-readable format (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
2. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — lowercases, trims, converts spaces to dashes, strips non-alphanumeric characters except dashes
3. **`fetchUsers(baseUrl)`** in src/api.js — fetches users from `/api/users`, logs count via the logger (not console.log per project convention), returns the array
